description: This Java class 'SimpleMethod' implements the <simple-method> element in the OFBiz Mini-language framework. It encapsulates the execution of mini-language scripts defined in XML for handling service or event logic, including support for operations, transactions, and context management.

classes.name: SimpleMethod
classes.description: Java class implementing the <simple-method> XML element for the OFBiz Mini-language, providing execution, configuration, and lifecycle management for mini-language scripts.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the defined operations of the SimpleMethod, managing context, transactions, and response handling based on service or event invocation.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method.

methods.name: getShortDescription
methods.description: Returns a short descriptor of the method, including filename and method name.

methods.name: getDefaultErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the default error response code.

methods.name: getDefaultSuccessCode
methods.description: Returns the default success response code.

methods.name: getUseTransaction
methods.description: Indicates whether the method runs within a transaction.

methods.name: getLoginRequired
methods.description: Indicates whether login is required to execute the method.

methods.name: getMethodOperations
methods.description: Returns the list of operation objects to execute.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename part from the fromLocation.

methods.name: getFromLocation
methods.description: Returns the full location string where the method was loaded from.

methods.name: getLocationAndName
methods.description: Returns a composite string of location and method name.

methods.name: addErrorMessage
methods.description: Adds an error message to the method context.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a general message to the method context.

methods.name: runSimpleEvent
methods.description: Executes a simple method as an event using request and response objects.

methods.name: runSimpleMethod
methods.description: Executes a named simple method from XML resource, returning a response string.

methods.name: runSimpleService
methods.description: Runs a SimpleMethod as part of a service call, returning a result map.
